title: Validating, Not Sampling: Region-Level Robustness of Vision-Language and Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.22293v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) and vision-language-action models (VLAs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications. There, a small perturbation to the recorded camera image may change a decision significantly. However, existing benchmarks for these models only sample perturbations, which does not guarantee the absence of a failure in the untested region. We present the first robustness validation of six VLMs (drawn from the Gemma, InternVL, LLaVA, and Qwen families) and five VLAs (drawn from the GR00T, OpenVLA, and $\pi$ families) over entire continuous regions of photometric and geometric image perturbation: brightness shifts, camera rotations, and their composition. To this end, we build on the validation framework H$^2$V and introduce H$^2$V-M, a margin-aware convergence rule that makes validation affordable at the 32B parameter scale. We demonstrate that H$^2$V-M outperforms H$^2$V by an order of magnitude in model queries

translated_title: 验证而非采样：视觉语言与视觉-语言-动作模型的区域级鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）和视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）正日益被部署到现实世界的应用中。在这些应用中，对采集的相机图像施加微小扰动可能会显著改变模型的决策。然而，现有的这些模型基准测试仅对扰动进行采样，无法保证在未测试区域内不会出现失败。我们首次对六个VLM（来自Gemma、InternVL、LLaVA和Qwen系列）和五个VLA（来自GR00T、OpenVLA和π系列）在光度与几何图像扰动的整个连续区域上进行了鲁棒性验证，涵盖亮度偏移、相机旋转及其组合。为此，我们在验证框架H²V的基础上提出了H²V-M，这是一种边缘感知的收敛规则，使得在320亿参数规模下进行验证变得可行。我们证明H²V-M在模型查询次数上比H²V高效一个数量级。
tldr: 首次对多种视觉语言与视觉-语言-动作模型在连续扰动区域上完成鲁棒性验证，提出的边缘感知收敛规则H²V-M使验证在32B参数规模下可行，且模型查询次数减少一个数量级。
en_tdlr: First robustness validation of VLMs and VLAs over entire continuous perturbation regions, introducing H²V-M, a margin-aware convergence rule that makes validation affordable at the 32B parameter scale with an order of magnitude fewer model queries.
